summary: Sawtelle is a West Los Angeles / Westside neighborhood associated with Japanese American history and Sawtelle Japantown.
Rental portal boundaries are loose: some nearby West LA, Rancho Park, Brentwood, Santa Monica, and Palms results show up as “Sawtelle.”
Most core 90025 whole-unit 3BR rents found cluster around $4,100-$5,500/month; lower apparent prices are often co-living or room listings.
transit: Expo/Bundy Metro E Line station is shown as the red M marker.
Bus access includes LA Metro Bus, Santa Monica Big Blue Bus, and Culver CityBus corridors.
Key roads nearby include Santa Monica Blvd, Olympic Blvd, Wilshire Blvd, Sepulveda Blvd, Bundy Dr, and I-405.
amenities: Stoner Recreation Center, West LA Regional Branch Library, Ralphs, Trader Joe’s, Nijiya Market, Gelson’s, Marukai, Smart & Final, and the Sawtelle Blvd restaurant corridor are nearby.
cautions: Check all monthly fees: parking, utilities, trash, internet, pets, amenity/admin fees, and move-in charges.
Tour during commute/evening hours for traffic/noise, especially near Santa Monica/Olympic/Wilshire/Sepulveda/Barrington/405.
Inspect package security, garage access, and bike storage.
Confirm RSO/AB 1482 status and exact LAUSD school boundaries by address.

methodology: Started from official city/college/YMCA/UCLA pages, not review snippets, and kept only facilities with indoor gym/basketball evidence or a clearly marked verify-first caveat.
Ranked by route distance from 225 Arizona Ave, while flagging whether a court is truly public drop-in, membership-based, college-affiliated, or verify-first.

Mapped each court with a dashed connector to the office and a blue connector to the nearest Metro E Line station. Use each card's directions links for live routing and current traffic/transit details.
Call ahead before going: open-gym schedules can be preempted by leagues, classes, camps, permits, and campus construction.

distance_notes.sourceDistanceMethod: Office miles are traffic-free OSRM driving-route miles from 225 Arizona Ave. Metro miles are OSRM route miles from each court to the nearest Metro E Line station; walking minutes are estimated at 20 min/mi because the public OSRM demo returns car-speed durations for foot routes.
distance_notes.mapMethod: Map connector lines are straight-line visual guides, not turn-by-turn route polylines; directions links open Google Maps for live routing.

courts.name: Santa Monica Family YMCA
courts.access: Gym access is membership/guest-pass based; verify free-play windows on the branch schedule.
courts.indoor_status: Confirmed gym; basketball programming/free-play noted by YMCA sources.
courts.rank_note: Closest indoor gym option to the office, but not true public drop-in.
courts.source_notes: YMCA location page lists a Gym among facilities; Santa Monica YMCA basketball page says youth games are held at the branch and the Y offers pick-up basketball/free-play windows at local YMCA locations.

courts.name: Memorial Park Gym and Fitness Room
courts.access: Public drop-in basketball; no advance reservation; low daily fee/pass listed by the City.
courts.rank_note: Best true public indoor drop-in option close to the office.
courts.source_notes: City page says Memorial Park Gym is popular for drop-in sports like basketball; the drop-in page lists weekday and Saturday basketball windows and daily fees.

courts.name: Santa Monica College Corsair Gym
courts.access: College facility; public drop-in was not confirmed from official sources. Best lead if someone can access SMC classes, campus programs, or events.
courts.indoor_status: Confirmed indoor college gym used for basketball classes/competitions.
courts.rank_note: Closest college-court lead, but treat as verify-first rather than guaranteed open gym.
courts.source_notes: SMC facilities page says Corsair Gym is home to classes and competitions in basketball, badminton, table tennis, volleyball, and other indoor sports. SMC maps page provides the main-campus address/coordinates; marker is approximate for the gym area.

courts.name: Rustic Canyon Recreation Center
courts.access: Public LA City recreation center; call ahead for open-gym hours and conflicts with classes/permits.
courts.indoor_status: Confirmed indoor/lighted basketball courts in facility features.
courts.rank_note: Strong public indoor-court fallback north of Santa Monica; not Metro-convenient.
courts.source_notes: LA Parks page lists basketball under sports/fitness and facility features include Basketball Courts (Lighted / Indoor).

courts.name: Stoner Recreation Center
courts.access: Public LA City recreation center with adult open-gym basketball references; verify current schedule before going.
courts.indoor_status: Gym/open-gym basketball noted; indoor basketball court details should be verified by phone.
courts.rank_note: Closest public West LA option near the Expo/Bundy station.
courts.source_notes: LA Parks page lists Basketball in sports/fitness programs and notes adult open gym basketball; page also references gym use/permits.

courts.name: Westwood Recreation Center
courts.address: 1350 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90025
courts.access: Public LA City recreation center; official page lists basketball programs/court, but indoor status/open-gym availability should be verified.
courts.indoor_status: Basketball court confirmed; indoor status not clearly confirmed in the official page extract.
courts.rank_note: Useful nearby backup, especially if Stoner is booked; verify indoor/open-gym before traveling.
courts.source_notes: LA Parks page lists Basketball in sports/fitness programs and Basketball Court in facility features, but the page labels the outdoor courts separately and does not clearly label the main court as indoor.

courts.name: UCLA John Wooden Center / Pardee Gym
courts.access: UCLA Recreation access is for registered UCLA students and eligible affiliates/community members with Rec membership; not casual public drop-in.
courts.indoor_status: Confirmed indoor college basketball; Collins Courts closed during JWC project and sport activity is relocated to Pardee Gym.
courts.rank_note: Best full college-rec option if someone has or can obtain UCLA Rec access; farthest from office among this shortlist.
courts.source_notes: UCLA Recreation page says JWC is available to registered students/faculty/staff/retirees/alumni/community members via Rec membership, and notes open-rec basketball in Pardee Gym during Collins Court closure; Collins Courts are described as an indoor basketball gymnasium with 3 full-sized courts.
